The rest are optional nits for whenever this is next refreshed.

messages.message:
Patch Set 4:

(2 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good overall - the aops handlers and their compat wrappers line up with the address_space_operations members on every kernel I traced (page/folio/kiocb write_begin, invalidatepage/invalidate_folio, readpage/read_folio, releasepage/release_folio, set_page_dirty/dirty_folio), and dropping the (void *) cast on .releasepage is a genuine improvement now that RELEASEPAGE_ARG_TYPE is gone. Only optional nits inline, no need to re-spin for them.

commit.message:
LU-18687 build: move aops compat code into fs.h

Migrate the aops handlers into compat specific handlers in
include/lustre_compat/fs.h

This also allows us to kill the wbe_* macros

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Shaun Tancheff <shaun@tancheff.com>
Change-Id: I900a1e73a44a3ce3abd387a5c573e8d7e9bad57f
